items.question: Are the five nyāsa positions colored white, red, dark, green, and yellow in sequence?
premises: The colors follow a fixed order.
items.inference: The nyāsa sequence is colored white, red, dark, green, and yellow.
uncertainties: The exact referent of the colored positions is not stated in this verse.
items.plain_english: White, red, dark, green, and yellow, incomparable, in order.
